```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(shiny)
library(shinydashboard)
library(shinythemes)

gapminder<-read_csv("C:/Users/Miala/OneDrive/Desktop/BIS15L_W2026_Group9/Gapminder/gapminder.csv")
#gapminder
```



```{r}
library(bslib)
theme<-bs_theme(bootswatch = "journal")

ui <- fluidPage(
titlePanel(  "Countries Throughout The Years"),
    
  dashboardPage( 
  
  
  dashboardHeader( ),
 
  dashboardSidebar(title = "Variables",
  
  
  selectInput("filter",
              "select country",
             choices = unique(gapminder$name),
    
 selected = "afghanistan"),
  
  selectInput("y",
              "Select Variable",
              choices = c("life_expectancy",
                          "Co2_emissions",
                          "population",
                          "gdp"),
           selected = "population")), 
    dashboardBody(
   
splitLayout( 
   plotOutput("plot1", width= "900px", height= "800px"),
 plotOutput("plot2", width = "900px", height = "800px"))
  
)))

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  output$plot1 <- renderPlot({
    
  gapminder %>% 
      filter(name== input$filter) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=year, y=.data[[input$y]], na.rm=T))+
scale_y_log10()+
  geom_line(aes(color= "yellow"))+
  geom_point(na.rm=T, shape=1, color= "blue")+
  scale_x_continuous()+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(hjust=1, size = 25),
        axis.text.y = element_text(hjust = 1, size = 20))+
  labs( x="Year")
    })
  
    output$plot2<-renderPlot({
    gapminder %>% 
 filter(name=="USA") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=year, y=.data[[input$y]]))+
  geom_line(aes(color="tomato"))+
  geom_point(shape=1, na.rm=T, color="blue")+
    scale_y_log10()+
  scale_x_continuous()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text( hjust=1, size=25),
        axis.text.y = element_text (hjust=1, size=20), 
        legend.position= "none")+
  labs(title="USA throughout years",
       x="Years")
      
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
